title: Solumn Thoughts (Alex AI Voice Cover)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
And I had always found my day
When I would save this pain
It's driving me insane

[Verse 2]

To say good morning today

[Verse 3]
Have you heard the tale I tell
Where I might as well
Hear the words I say

[Verse 4]

If it would have been on time
Now

[Verse 5]

Syllables and letters
The better of the sun
And the day it'll never go away
Just to become tomorrows today
I'll say today was right
In the side of my eyes

[Verse 6]
So please, hold my hand tonight
So I won't feel so detached
That the magic's burning away the past
As the sun shines down on yesterday's
Tomorrow and I know

[Verse 7]
That I will never find
Another peace of mind 
where I will never go 
to know what could be won
A balance restored to the world where
I would never find a time where
I would live to give your heart to me to say
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah

[Verse 8]

To say your final thoughts
You're caught in the loop
Where I will never find a way to say
So cry as I try to find
Something I never lost
Its been there all along
Why could I be strong to survive every fight
I've attacked myself with confidence on the shelf
Where we've not been found for many years
Where I said goodbye tonight, I'm sure
Today, tonight

title: Try to Forget You (Alex AI Voice Cover)
lyrics:

I left these things to remember us left behind

Too far again to you

[Chorus]
Everything I do, I do to forget you
And everything I burn, I burn in this fire
I'll burn away these days, a new game to play

If my love was dead before my time
My time is done

Break my heart

Has begun

Their last breath

[Chorus]

That I'm to never love
Because I am
The one who can't be loved

[Verse 2]
If my love was something you cared about
Cared about
Then the road is long and filled with trials to overcome
So one day to see if you truly care
Truly cared
A futile point that must be proven for our sake
For our sake

[Chorus]
And now I know my truth
That I'm to never love
Because I am
The one who can't be loved

[Outro]
And some things are just not meant to be
When that what is meant for me
This is the end of our tale
Maybe one day to reborn
But till then I'll sing this sad song
But till then I'll sing this sad song
Cause I'm one who can't be loved
